requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) implies 17.9 p1 IEEE arithmetic facilities for X kind
requirements.definition: With X present and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) true, 17.9 p1 supplies the listed normal-format and operation conformance requirements for X's real kind.

pending.IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE-scalar-array-same-: For a scalar x=1.0_rk and an array xa=[1.0_rk,2.0_rk] of the same real kind, assign IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(x) and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(xa) to logical sentinels initialized to opposite values, then assert IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(x) .EQV. IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(xa). Mutation changes xa to a different real kind.
pending.IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE-true-normal-number: Branch on IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0). True branch uses IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(-1.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(TINY(1.0)), and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(HUGE(1.0)) before IEEE_CLASS observers, then asserts IEEE_CLASS(1.0)==IEEE_POSITIVE_NORMAL, IEEE_CLASS(-1.0)==IEEE_NEGATIVE_NORMAL, IEEE_CLASS(TINY(1.0))==IEEE_POSITIVE_NORMAL, and IEEE_CLASS(HUGE(1.0))==IEEE_POSITIVE_NORMAL; false branch records a skip for 17.9 p1 normal-format effects.
pending.IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE-true-add-subtract-: Branch on IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.5), and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(2.0). True branch initializes result sentinels to -99.0 and asserts 1.5+0.5 == 2.0, 1.5-0.5 == 1.0, and 1.5*2.0 == 3.0; all operands and results are normal and exactly representable, so no rounding-mode choice changes the expected values. False branch records a skip for 17.9 p1 normal arithmetic effects.
pending.IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE-true-abs-facility: Branch on IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(-1.5) and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.5). True branch initializes a real sentinel to -99.0, evaluates ABS(-1.5), and asserts the exact result 1.5; false branch records a skip for the 17.9 p1 abs facility.
pending.IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE-true-ieee-rem-faci: Branch on IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(5.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(2.0). True branch initializes a real sentinel to -99.0, evaluates IEEE_REM(5.0,2.0), and asserts the exact ISO remainder 1.0; false branch records a skip for the 17.9 p1 remainder facility.
pending.IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE-true-ieee-copy-sig: Branch on IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.5) and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(-2.0). True branch initializes a real sentinel to 99.0, evaluates IEEE_COPY_SIGN(1.5,-2.0), and asserts the exact value -1.5; false branch records a skip for the 17.9 p1 copySign facility.
pending.IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE-true-ieee-logb-fac: Branch on IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(REAL(RADIX(1.0),KIND(1.0))). True branch initializes real sentinels to -99.0, sets x=1.0 and b=REAL(RADIX(x),KIND(x)), evaluates IEEE_LOGB(x) and IEEE_LOGB(b), and asserts the radix-free exact results 0.0 and 1.0 respectively; false branch records a skip for the 17.9 p1 logB facility.
pending.IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE-true-ieee-unordere: Branch on IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(2.0). True branch initializes a logical sentinel to .true., evaluates IEEE_UNORDERED(1.0,2.0), and asserts .false.; an extended branch that also observes IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(1.0) constructs QNAN=IEEE_VALUE(1.0,IEEE_QUIET_NAN) and asserts IEEE_UNORDERED(QNAN,1.0) and IEEE_UNORDERED(1.0,QNAN) are true using IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(QNAN) before the restricted unordered calls. False branch records a skip for the 17.9 p1 compareQuietUnordered facility.
